input.text: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.
sources: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.

input.text: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account. When the branch manager approves, staff can instead collect one form plus a verified bank reference.
sources: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.

input.text: An account is treated as a new account for the first 30 days after it opens.
sources: An account is treated as a new account for the first 30 days after it opens.

input.text: Whenever a teller drawer goes above $15,000, sell the excess cash to the vault.
sources: Sell excess cash to the vault whenever a teller drawer goes above $15,000.

input.text: Log any cash deposit or withdrawal of $7,500 or more for large-cash review.
sources: Log any cash deposit or withdrawal of $7,500 or more for large-cash review.
